title: Proof Bundle v0
description: The portable canonical manifest for one Proof of Loop export. Unknown object properties are retained and reported as warnings by readers; unknown enum values remain invalid for this version-pinned contract.

schema_version.description: The versioned identifier of this Proof Bundle contract.

proof_id.description: The SHA-256 identity of the canonical Bundle payload, excluding transport metadata.

run_id.description: The profile-independent SHA-256 identity of the source Loop Run.

profile.description: The versioned verification profile that governed this export.

name.description: The stable profile name selected for this export.

schema_hash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the exact profile document used for this export.

explorer.description: Optional renderer attestations for the packaged offline Explorer. Current proof open requires these bindings; legacy Bundles may omit the whole object.

assets.description: Canonical SHA-256 attestations for each static Explorer file.

index.html.description: SHA-256 attestation for the Explorer HTML entry point.

app.js.description: SHA-256 attestation for the Explorer application script.

styles.css.description: SHA-256 attestation for the Explorer stylesheet.

source.description: Repository and exporter facts recorded for the source delivery.

repo_name.description: The source repository name without local filesystem paths.

base_commit.description: The commit from which the Loop Run began, or null for a legacy gap.

anyOf.description: A deliberately recorded unknown legacy value.

head_commit.description: The true final commit of the Run, or null when a legacy Run did not record it.

anyOf.description: A deliberately recorded unknown legacy value.

reviewed_commit.description: The commit covered by the final review, or null when it was not recorded.

anyOf.description: A deliberately recorded unknown legacy value.

loop_version.description: The Loop version that produced the source artifacts.

exporter_version.description: The exporter version that compiled this Bundle.

commits.description: Derived Git commit records for the recorded base-to-head range; public profiles may redact selected metadata fields.

items.description: One immutable Git commit record derived from the source repository.

sha.description: The full Git object identifier for this commit.

subject.description: The one-line Git commit subject retained for review context.

authored_at.description: The commit author timestamp normalized to UTC whole-second precision.

author_name.description: The Git author display name retained by the selected profile.

author_email.description: The Git author email when the selected profile permits this derived metadata.

specification.description: The original delivery goal and its immutable acceptance criteria.

goal.description: The stated goal of the delivery.

acceptance_criteria.description: The stable acceptance criteria in their recorded order; this can be empty only when a legacy or unparseable source artifact supplied no criteria.

text_sha256.description: The raw SHA-256 hash of the recorded criterion text.

run.description: The source Loop Run's terminal facts, rounds, and events.

session_timestamp.description: The UTC start timestamp recorded for the Run, or null for a legacy gap.

anyOf.description: A UTC ISO-8601 timestamp at whole-second precision.
A deliberately recorded unknown legacy value.

terminal_state.description: The terminal lifecycle state that made the Run eligible for export.

rounds.description: The Run rounds in chronological order.

index.description: The zero-based ordinal used by the Run identity projection.

events.description: Recorded lifecycle events for the Run.

kind.description: The event kind recorded by the Run Adapter.

at.description: The UTC event timestamp, or null when the source artifact lacks one.

anyOf.description: A UTC ISO-8601 timestamp at whole-second precision.
A deliberately recorded unknown source value.

round.description: The zero-based round associated with this event when recorded.

verdict.description: The structured mainline progress verdict recorded for a review event.

stall_count.description: The consecutive stalled or regressed round count recorded by a circuit breaker.

last_mainline_verdict.description: The last recorded mainline verdict when a circuit breaker fires.

drift_status.description: The recorded Loop drift state associated with a circuit-breaker event.

detail.description: A bounded adapter-generated explanation for the lifecycle event.

evidence_refs.description: Included Evidence Item IDs supporting this event's displayed facts.

evidence.description: Evidence Items collected or explicitly withheld by the export profile.

items.description: One evidence item and its content-addressed declaration.

id.description: The stable evidence identifier derived from source path and content hash.

path.description: The source path relative to the Loop Run directory.

sha256.description: The raw SHA-256 hash of the original evidence bytes.

bytes.description: The original evidence size in bytes.

kind.description: The normalized evidence classification used by profiles and the Explorer.

status.description: Whether the source evidence is included, omitted, or truncated in this Bundle.

omitted_reason.description: The reason an item is omitted, or null when it remains available.

oneOf.description: No omission reason because the item remains available.
A named profile or size reason for withholding the item.

findings.description: Structured review findings and their evidence relationships.

items.description: One review finding with a conservative lifecycle state.

severity.description: The review severity assigned to the finding.

status.description: The evidence-backed lifecycle state of the finding.

found_round.description: The zero-based round ordinal in which the finding was recorded.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence identifiers supporting or contextualizing this finding.

ac_refs.description: Acceptance criterion identifiers affected by this finding.

verdict.description: The profile-relative delivery verdict and per-criterion status matrix.

per_ac.description: The verdict recorded for every acceptance criterion.

status.description: The conservative status derived for this criterion.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of the derived status.

supporting.description: Evidence identifiers supporting the criterion status.

contradicting.description: Evidence identifiers contradicting the criterion status.

required_set.description: Criterion identifiers that remain required for an accept conclusion.

deferred.description: Criteria removed from the required set through recorded replanning.

items.description: One deferred criterion and its recorded replan evidence.

replan_ref.description: The evidence reference authorizing the deferral.

integrity.description: Compilation-time integrity warnings recorded without changing delivery verdict semantics.

status.description: The compiler's conservative integrity projection for offline Explorer display.

compile_warnings.description: Warnings discovered while compiling the Bundle.

target.description: The Bundle field or source artifact affected by the warning.

detail.description: A specific human-readable explanation of the warning.

disclosure.description: The profile-driven declaration of omitted evidence and redacted fields.

omitted.description: Evidence paths withheld from this profile-specific Bundle.

path.description: The source-relative evidence path that was omitted.

reason.description: The profile or privacy reason for omitting this evidence.

field_redactions.description: Derived record fields removed or masked by the selected profile.

field.description: The logical field path affected by the redaction.

reason.description: The profile rule that required the redaction.

transport.description: Non-identity export transport metadata excluded from proof_id computation.

exported_at.description: The UTC time at which this Bundle was written.

exporter_host_class.description: A non-identifying class of the host that wrote this Bundle.
